name: Developer Portal
description: Extension developer hub — publish and manage your own extensions, track deployment status, view earnings analytics, request payouts, and validate manifests against federal SDK rules.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_developer_status
tools.description: Provide developer tier, app count, and earnings to the AI context.

tools.name: register_developer
tools.description: Register as a developer (Explorer tier is free)

return_schema.title: DeveloperRegistration

tools.name: create_app
tools.description: Create a new extension app (requires Git URL)

return_schema.description:
An extension app (kind='app').

Mirrors AppResponse (returned verbatim by create_app / update_app_info /
update_pricing / save_pricing): app_id, developer_id, display_name,
description, category, icon, git_url, status, reject_reason,
pricing_model, pricing_config, revenue_split_dev, created_at, updated_at.
return_schema.title: AppRecord

return_schema.description:
Receipt for suspend_app (kind='app').

Mirrors the raw POST /v1/developer/apps/{app_id}/suspend response (loosely
typed; the gateway typically echoes app_id/status).
return_schema.title: SuspendReceipt

tools.name: delete_app
tools.description: Permanently delete an app. Must be suspended first. Requires typing the exact app_id to confirm. THIS CANNOT BE UNDONE.

confirm_name.description: Type the app_id to confirm deletion
confirm_name.title: Confirm Name

return_schema.description:
Receipt for delete_app (kind='app').

Mirrors the raw DELETE /v1/developer/apps/{app_id} response (loosely typed).
return_schema.title: DeleteAppReceipt

tools.name: update_app_info
tools.description: Update app info (name, description, git URL) — works on active apps

return_schema.description:
An extension app (kind='app').

Mirrors AppResponse (returned verbatim by create_app / update_app_info /
update_pricing / save_pricing): app_id, developer_id, display_name,
description, category, icon, git_url, status, reject_reason,
pricing_model, pricing_config, revenue_split_dev, created_at, updated_at.
return_schema.title: AppRecord

tools.name: update_pricing
tools.description: Update app pricing model (requires paused app)

return_schema.description:
An extension app (kind='app').

Mirrors AppResponse (returned verbatim by create_app / update_app_info /
update_pricing / save_pricing): app_id, developer_id, display_name,
description, category, icon, git_url, status, reject_reason,
pricing_model, pricing_config, revenue_split_dev, created_at, updated_at.
return_schema.title: AppRecord

tools.name: save_pricing
tools.description: Save pricing model and per-tool prices from the pricing form

return_schema.description:
An extension app (kind='app').

Mirrors AppResponse (returned verbatim by create_app / update_app_info /
update_pricing / save_pricing): app_id, developer_id, display_name,
description, category, icon, git_url, status, reject_reason,
pricing_model, pricing_config, revenue_split_dev, created_at, updated_at.
return_schema.title: AppRecord

tools.name: deploy_app
tools.description: Clone or pull extension from Git, validate, and report results

return_schema.description:
Receipt for deploy_app (kind='deploy').

Mirrors the EXACT dict deploy_app builds: app_id, commit, status,
validation, tools_synced, panels_synced, icon_synced, manifest_synced,
migrations_applied.
return_schema.title: DeployReceipt

tools.name: request_payout
tools.description: Request a payout of your available earnings

return_schema.description:
Receipt for request_payout (kind='payout').

Mirrors the raw auth-gateway POST /v1/developer/payouts/request response
(loosely typed — known keys carried as Optional pass-through; the request
amount/method come from params, the gateway echoes id/status when present).

amount_tokens.description: Requested payout amount in platform tokens.
amount_tokens.title: Amount Tokens

return_schema.title: PayoutRequestReceipt

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.description: View total earnings across all your apps

return_schema.description:
Aggregate earnings across all of a developer's apps (kind='earnings').

Shape mirrors ``GET /v1/developer/earnings`` (EarningsResponse) as returned
verbatim by ``get_earnings`` (``data=result``): total_earnings,
total_platform_share, pending_payout, paid_out.

total_earnings.description: Total tokens earned across all apps (lifetime).
total_earnings.title: Total Earnings

total_platform_share.description: Total tokens taken as platform share (lifetime).
total_platform_share.title: Total Platform Share

pending_payout.description: Tokens available for payout right now.
pending_payout.title: Pending Payout

return_schema.title: EarningsSummary

tools.name: get_earnings_by_app
tools.description: View earnings for a specific app

return_schema.description:
Earnings scoped to a single app (kind='appearnings').

Shape mirrors ``GET /v1/developer/earnings/{app_id}`` (EarningsByAppResponse)
as returned verbatim by ``get_earnings_by_app`` (``data=result``): app_id,
total_earnings, action_count, by_period.

total_earnings.description: Total tokens earned by this app (lifetime).
total_earnings.title: Total Earnings

action_count.description: Total billable actions for this app (lifetime).
action_count.title: Action Count

return_schema.title: AppEarnings

PayoutRecord.description:
One payout request (kind='payout').

Mirrors PayoutResponse (``GET /v1/developer/payouts`` items): id,
developer_id, amount_tokens, amount_usd, status, method, admin_note,
requested_at, processed_at.
PayoutRecord.title: PayoutRecord

tools.name: save_app_secret
tools.description: Save the value of a declared secret for one of your extensions. PUTs to auth-gw /v1/secrets/{app_id}/{name}; plaintext is encrypted by Vault transit before storage.

app_id.description: The extension to save the secret for.
app_id.title: App Id

return_schema.description:
Receipt for save_app_secret (kind='secret').

Mirrors the EXACT dict save_app_secret builds: {ok, app_id, name}.
return_schema.title: SecretSaveReceipt

tools.name: delete_app_secret
tools.description: Delete the value of a declared secret for one of your extensions.

app_id.description: The extension whose secret to delete.
app_id.title: App Id

return_schema.description:
Receipt for delete_app_secret (kind='secret').

Mirrors the EXACT dict delete_app_secret builds: {ok, was_set}.
return_schema.title: SecretDeleteReceipt

return_schema.description:
Receipt for submit_for_review (kind='appsubmit').

Mirrors AppSubmitResponse (returned verbatim): status, checks.
return_schema.title: SubmitReceipt
